read.title: Collaboration Proposal from Glowlab
read.text:
Hi Mia,

We're big fans of your content, especially your honest skincare reviews. I'm the marketing manager at Glowlab, a Korean skincare brand.

Would you be interested in a paid collaboration for our new sunscreen? We are looking for one Instagram Reel and two Stories in April. We'll send you free products first, so you can try them before deciding.

If this sounds good, I'll send you the campaign brief with the timeline and fee.

Best,
Minsu
